details.description: GLM-4.7 is Z.ai's (formerly Zhipu AI) open-weight Mixture-of-Experts language model, released December 22, 2025, with 358 billion total parameters, per its Hugging Face model card, and 32 billion active parameters per token, per Z.ai's GitHub repository. It targets agentic software-engineering workflows -- multi-file coding, end-to-end task execution, and stable multi-step tool use -- and supports interleaved and preserved thinking that carries reasoning context across turns, per Z.ai's documentation. It is a text-only model with a 200K-token context window. As of September 2026, Z.ai's newer GLM-5 series (through GLM-5.3) has become the flagship, though GLM-4.7 remains listed as an active, available model.
advantages: Scores 73.8% on SWE-bench Verified, a 5.8-point improvement over GLM-4.6, per its Hugging Face model card.
Scores 84.9 on LiveCodeBench-v6, ahead of the 64.0 Z.ai attributes to Claude Sonnet 4.5 on the same comparison table, per its Hugging Face model card.
Supports interleaved thinking, thinking that persists across conversation turns, and per-turn thinking controls, per Z.ai's documentation.
358 billion total parameters and 32 billion active per token in a Mixture-of-Experts architecture, per its Hugging Face model card and Z.ai's GitHub repository.
disadvantages: Superseded as Z.ai's flagship chat model by the GLM-5 series (through GLM-5.3, released August 2026), per Z.ai's release-notes page, though GLM-4.7 remains an active, available model.
Text-only model; does not accept image or other non-text input, per Z.ai's API documentation.
use_cases: Multi-file software engineering and end-to-end coding task completion
Agentic workflows with multi-step tool use and orchestration

sources.title: New Released - Overview - Z.AI DEVELOPER DOCUMENT

notes: This target's catalog facts (max_input_tokens and max_output_tokens both 202800, via Fireworks) differ from Z.ai's own native-API documentation, which states a 200K-token context window with up to 128K max output tokens; kept the catalog's value per instructions since it reflects Fireworks' own serving limit rather than a conflicting claim about the model itself. Benchmark figures were re-verified directly against the GLM-4.7 Hugging Face model card's comparison table in this research pass.
